body.statement: On \(\mathcal E_{0n}\cap\mathcal E_{1n}\cap\mathcal Q_n\), the unique exact-balancing weights imply \(Q_n^{\top}d_n=0\) and \(\mathbb E[\|b_{E,n}\|_2^2\mid Q_n,A_n]=\|L_nD_nu_n\|_2^2+\operatorname{tr}(L_nD_nV_nD_nL_n^{\top})\), with \(L_n=(Q_n^\top Q_n)^{-1}Q_n^\top\) on this event. At \(\gamma=1\), on the same certified event, the two terms and their covariance corrections admit deterministic resolvent limits under the original same-sample entropy weights on an interval containing \(\kappa=1/8\), and the resulting limit recovers \(r_E=\kappa/(8\lambda)+o(\kappa)\) as \(\kappa\downarrow0\). No identity or entropy-balance conclusion is asserted for the uniform fallback on the complement.
body.justification: This is the early kill test for whether coherent leverage and Jacobian terms have a finite closure.
body.gap: LuYangWang2025 controls proportional linear and quadratic leverage for regression adjustment, but the diagonal weights here are endogenous exponential tilts sharing the same Gaussian rows.
body.consumer: Passing this test validates the strong-penalty benchmark required to trust any full phase diagram.

obligation.what_is_open: A deterministic equivalent for the two endogenous same-sample entropy-weighted resolvent terms at signal one, including their conditional concentration and the uniform small-aspect-ratio link to fixed-penalty regret.
obligation.obstruction: The diagonal entropy weights and the least-squares resolvent are functions of the same Gaussian rows. The frozen assumptions provide neither a leave-one-out response theorem nor weighted-leverage bounds strong enough to replace these objects by marginal tilt moments.
obligation.attempted: The exact balance cancellation and conditional Bernoulli decomposition were completed. A marginal-weight or independent-weight substitution was rejected because it drops nonvanishing coherent leverage terms and changes the estimator.
obligation.partial_result:
Write \(A_n=(A_{n1},\ldots,A_{nn})^{\top}\). The finite-sample part is proved exactly: on the certified event,
\[
 Q_n^{\top}d_n=0,
 \qquad
 \mathbb E\!\left[\|b_{E,n}\|_2^2\mid Q_n,A_n\right]
 =\|L_nD_nu_n\|_2^2+
 \operatorname{tr}(L_nD_nV_nD_nL_n^{\top}),
\]
and \(L_n=(Q_n^{\top}Q_n)^{-1}Q_n^{\top}\).  This identity retains both the coherent conditional-mean term and the endogenous weighted-leverage trace.  No deterministic equivalent for either same-sample term has been established from the frozen assumptions.
